$comment: A network-check finding (id, its three figures) → the sentence every shell shows, pinned by pf-client-core findings, the Kotlin SpeedTestTest and the Swift SpeedTestView tests. Figures round the f64 value half-to-even with a '.' separator in every locale; 15 and 25 hundredths sit on and near a tie. An id the build doesn't know reads 'Finding N.'.
